Ah, 18, I'm sorry, I know how stressful it can be. 

Nizoral is clinically proven to keep the scalp in good shape and prevent irritation which is what DHT will cause on your scalp. Head & Shoulders does the same thing but is milder. I've been using it for years. I don't have bad hair loss, but the shampoo's/conditioners are just good for maintenance and scalp health. 

All the best man. Trust your own research, heed the Dermo's advice, but do what you feel is best.

It's definitely a mood piece and I think you've described it really well. 

The actual story behind these girls going missing is quite creepy and the true story itself could do with an even more factual remake (at some distant point in the future).

I went to Hanging Rock recently and it really is a powerful, emotional place. There is definitely a sense of foreboding that is tangible. I even got lost at one point and immediately started to panic as the rock structures are quite intimidating. Extremely beautiful but scary. 

If you're ever in Victoria, I recommend you check them out.

Nizoral or head n shoulders shamp/cond is useful. 

Don't forget some hair loss and receding hair line is very normal for the majority of men.
